operator_signal: Accepted-then-killed mid-turn TUI frozen Waiting frame; restore TypeScript showError parity. Parent approved severity/visibility-only scope, exact end-state persistence after cancellation.
hypothesis: Rust SessionClosed(killed) reaches the direct TUI but its info note is replaceable. A later turn-failed cancellation status and WaitRender timeout obscure it, unlike TS showError which appends a persistent error row.
approach: Use an e2e live supervisor, delayed fake provider, and externally observed worker GetConnectionState.isStreaming admission before kill; assert final rendered frame after prompt-cancel status contains exact TS close-error text and no old info note. Per-test probes established direct-recv -> matching apply -> frame info text -> cancellation overwrite; probes removed. Restrict production change to killed SessionClosed error_row severity.
